description: This file defines the WizardPagesAdapter class, which extends FragmentStateAdapter to manage a list of wizard page fragments for a setup or onboarding flow in an Android application. It dynamically constructs a list of fragments based on device API level and a boolean flag, providing methods to create fragments and get the total count.

classes.name: WizardPagesAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing wizard page fragments in a ViewPager2 setup, dynamically including fragments based on device API level and configuration.

methods.name: WizardPagesAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of fragments based on device API level and whether language download is enabled.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment at the specified position in the adapter.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of fragments managed by the adapter.
